snippet.title: Apartment No 129 | Cinematic Trailer
snippet.description:
Apartment No 129 | Cinematic Trailer Emir, who has an interest in mysterious events, steps alone into the abandoned apartment known as "Apartment No 129" to trace the trail of a paranormal event that occurred in 2009 and shook the country. However, he will find himself in an unexpected confrontation within this cursed apartment.
